source_path_amendment: After the failed 269-character MSVC input path, both variants relocate the fixed checkout with a verified copy and retained backup to equally short physical roots: C:\rust-src for control, D:\rust-src for NVMe. All build steps run there. Relocation is included in production wall time; no compiler flags or source changed.
purpose: Fork-only storage experiment; not an upstream patch or shipping claim.
workload: Unmodified upstream dist-aarch64-msvc configure arguments and full x.py dist bootstrap --include-default-paths, including Arm64EC and MSI.
treatment: Default ReFS Dev Drive on one verified unused NVMe; relocate workspace and Cargo home; retain original directories as backups. Leave TEMP/TMP and RUNNER_TEMP, toolchains, compiler configuration and Defender settings unchanged.
control: Default C: workspace and Cargo home; the same eligibility audit and compiler source/tool setup.

cache_conditions.cold: Fresh VM and empty local sccache directory.
cache_conditions.restored: Another fresh VM, restoring the same variant/pair's complete compiler-cache artifact from its cold job; source/build outputs are not restored.
cache_conditions.limitations: These are local compiler-cache conditions, not upstream's private S3 cache or a fully warm Cargo/download cache. Record actual hit counts rather than assuming all requests hit.

design.unit: Independent fresh runner per variant, cache condition and pair.
design.failure_policy: Keep failed/timed-out jobs and reasons. No performance claim until at least three successful matched pairs per cache condition; do not replace failures invisibly.
design.matching: Require identical compiler source, image version and processor count per pair, with visible memory within 1 MiB to tolerate firmware reservations on the same nominal memory capacity. This tolerance was set from inventory before any distribution timing result. Preserve job start times and scheduling order; retain and reject mismatched-image attempts.

qualification.all_jobs: Disk guard tests and hosted relocation/cache/failure tests gate builds; require full artifact manifest, extracted native rustc/cargo execution and Arm64EC object compilation.
qualification.pilot_cold_pair: Run the complete upstream opt-dist extracted-distribution test selection without additional skips on both variants. Retain NTFS temporary paths.
qualification.scope: A qualified performance experiment, not complete release/shipping qualification.

measurements: Storage setup time, checkout/dependency/cache transfer steps and full distribution wall time.
Bootstrap metrics for LLVM/compiler/tools/docs/packaging where available; avoid summing overlapping nested scopes.
Whole-VM busy CPU time during distribution, explicitly not process-tree CPU.
Production-to-distribution completion: job start through successful full distribution step.
Experiment-job wall: includes cache snapshot upload, qualification, evidence uploads and post-job cleanup; report separately from production scope.
Artifact names, sizes and hashes; final free space; sccache hits/misses; failed commands.

decision_rule.candidate_worth_followup: All safety/correctness gates pass, median paired production-to-distribution reduction is at least 5% in both cache conditions, and no matched production pair regresses more than 5%.
decision_rule.inconclusive: Insufficient matched pairs, differing images/resources, unexplained failures, or effects dominated by cache/setup differences.
decision_rule.statistics: Report each pair and median percentage reduction separately by cache mode. Three pairs are preliminary evidence; observed ranges are not confidence intervals.
decision_rule.no_gain: Preserve a null/negative result; do not infer Rust benefit from the earlier IronRDP measurement.
